description: This file defines an internal class 'ConnectionBuilderDelegates' that manages a list of configuration delegates (actions) for connection building, allowing addition and invocation of these delegates.

classes.name: ConnectionBuilderDelegates
classes.description: A class that manages a list of configuration delegates for connection building, allowing adding new delegates and invoking all stored delegates.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a configuration delegate to the internal list, throwing an ArgumentNullException if the delegate is null.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes all stored configuration delegates on the provided IConnectionBuilder instance.
